source_review: Every published Rust source matches the locked archive checksum and exact committed release. Histogram is allocation-free shared arithmetic; local code owns bounds, sample admission, lifetime and reporting.
catalog: Compatible 0.2.4 minimum is the first published histogram owner; incoming published 0.2.7 lock selection is retained. Default features disabled; no sibling patch or counter adapter.
compatibility: Additive copied histogram getter. Existing seven summary getter identities and semantics remain; prepared bytes derive from the histogram summary. One compatible 0.5.2 draft; package and released receipt remain 0.5.1.

histogram.owner: One successful prepared-chunk histogram; no second byte aggregate
histogram.admission: Successfully returned UploadData payloads only; zero and repeated preparation are samples. Failures and non-data results excluded. The payload owner independently enforces 1 MiB.
histogram.lifetime: Empty per create/open guard; Copy + Send + Sync views, diagnostic poison recovery, no persistence/labels/global registry/reset
histogram.storage: Four bounds, four counts and overflow add nine u64 fields (72 bytes); unchanged six duration summaries. No heap allocation. Native Rust layout measurement retained separately.
histogram.recording_work: One existing summary update plus one saturating bucket update, at most four inclusive comparisons; no extra clock or remote call. No speed-up or IC-cycle claim.
histogram.saturation: Buckets, summary samples and total saturate independently. A saturated total does not erase unsaturated distribution. Exact percentiles and exact saturated arithmetic are unavailable.

native_layout_measurement.scope: Observed Linux Rust layout, not stable ABI or timing evidence.

qualification.status: passed focused native Linux checks; uncommitted native macOS delivery pending
qualification.scope: Original 0.2.6 graph: native Linux arithmetic/routing and actual guarded filesystem/public upload journeys; no live IC or native macOS qualification. Current 0.2.7 graph qualification is recorded in follow_up_selection_review.
qualification.guarded_scope: Real source descriptors; deliberate diagnostic mutex poison recovers through successful metadata/data preparation, returned failures and unchanged journal bytes. Zero/repeated chunks, missing source and empty reopen preserve actual outcomes.
qualification.initial_failure: clippy.log retained: 296-byte helper value parameter exceeds lint threshold; helper now borrows the copied view without suppression.

remaining: Duration distributions await a concrete workload. Diagnostics never establish unique progress, spending, freshness, receipt, outcome, terminal proof or release. Production transport and runners remain unimplemented.
